formula_evidence.name: Shared control encoder
formula_evidence.meaning: Final control feature β_i is concatenation of linear-projected position embedding of point cloud and repeated type embedding.

formula_evidence.name: Training objective
formula_evidence.meaning: Flow matching loss with joint condition c' = [c, β_i].
